responsibility: This file defines the H8/300 backend’s register, immediate, memory, and special-purpose operand constraints used by the machine description and reload. It owns target-specific constraint letters for register classes, short and signed immediates, bit-operation destinations, constant-address memory forms, pre-inc/pre-dec addressing exclusions, and frame-pointer-sensitive scratch selection, thereby controlling which operands individual .md patterns may accept and how reload chooses alternatives for H8, H8S, and H8SX instruction forms.
